In einem kleinen, spezialisierten Team verbinden Sie Ihre Expertise in der Kostenrechnung mit der Nähe zum Werk. Als betriebswirtschaftliche Ansprechperson arbeiten Sie unmittelbar mit den Verantwortlichen der Produktion zusammen. Ihr Wirkungsbereich Sie übersetzen Zahlen, Daten und Fakten aus dem Werk in Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Für die Produkte übernehmen Sie die Kalkulation und gehen den Material- und Herstellkosten auf den Grund. Sie bereiten Berichte und Abweichungsanalysen auf, erläutern die Ergebnisse und entwickeln das Berichtswesen weiter. Sie wirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsabläufen, Systemen und IT-Reporting-Strukturen mit. Das bringen Sie mit Mehrjährige Praxis im Controlling; Erfahrung im Werkscontrolling eines produzierenden Unternehmens ist besonders willkommen. Ausgeprägtes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denken sowie eine hohe Fähigkeit, Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen zu finden. Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Fachbereiche wie die Werksleitung für Veränderungen zu gewinnen. Ein paar Worte zum Schluss Für unseren Kunden ist dies eine absolute Schlüsselrolle! Wenn Sie Zahlen nicht nur analysieren, sondern mit Ihren Erkenntnissen

jobs.title: (Senior) IT Security Consultant – Vulnerability Management & Container Security (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du möchtest Sicherheitslücken nicht nur identifizieren, sondern deren Analyse, Bewertung und Behebung durch intelligente Prozesse und Automatisierung nachhaltig verbessern? Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit Security-Tools, APIs und Container-Technologien und möchtest auch KI gezielt für effizientere Security-Prozesse einsetzen? Bei carmasec unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Infrastrukturen sicherer zu machen. Unser Team aus Security-Expert:innen arbeitet mit viel technischer Freiheit, kollegialer Unterstützung und minimaler Reisetätigkeit in anspruchsvollen Projekten. Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig . Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur . Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team. Aufgaben Du analysierst, bewertest und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken anhand von CVE, CVSS, Exploitability und dem jeweiligen Risikokontext und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Du implementierst, konfigurierst und entwickelst Vulnerability-Management-Plattformen wie DefectDojo weiter , um Schwachstellen zentral zu erfassen, zu bewerten und nachzuverfolgen. Du integrierst unterschiedliche Security-Scanner und optimierst die Konsolidierung, Normalisierung und Deduplizierung von Security Findings. Du entwickelst und automatisierst Security-Workflows für die Bewertung, Zuordnung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen und setzt dafür APIs, Skripte und geeignete Schnittstellen ein. Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Ansätze zur Analyse, Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Security Findings und integrierst diese in bestehende Security-Prozesse. Du analysierst und sicherst Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Umgebungen ab , identifizierst Schwachstellen in Container-Infrastrukturen und setzt Maßnahmen für Container Hardening und sichere Konfigurationen um. Du beräts

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. About The Role As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey. This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office. What You’ll Do Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together. Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners. Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs. Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement. jobs.description: About Us Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the Role: We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others. Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most. We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority initiatives across the business. Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges. Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows. Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution. Research new markets, products, and business opportunities. Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions. Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges. Comfortable working across different business functions. Strong ownership and execution skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. Curious, resource

Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step. Team mission GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time. Your mission As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: About the Position We’re looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You’ll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models.  We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street’s research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning.  Beyond our own environment, we also recognize the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We’re also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we’re interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined. If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of our newest hires . About You We don’t expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we’re looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: About the position We re looking to add a passionate Cybersecurity Engineer to our London office to help protect Jane Street’s employees, data, and infrastructure from the wilds of the internet. Our Cybersecurity Engineers are responsible for developing and using monitoring tools to guard the firm, as well as handling incident response and remediation when a threat is found. Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. We consider ourselves to be tapped into developments in the broader cybersecurity space, and can tell the difference between the latest cool hack by security researchers and what actually matters in our day-to-day. In this role, you’ll carefully consider the context of our decisions as we think about the tradeoffs we’re making in our approach to resolving cybersecurity issues. We’ll expect you to apply a methodical approach to performing unstructured investigations to locate and repair the source of a security issue. You will also act as an ambassador of best practices to the rest of the firm. Team members understand and practice good personal cybersecurity hygiene, and are able to talk to others about it. A key component of doing well in this position is bringing everyone else along with you on the cybersecurity journey, and you should be excited to learn from your colleagues and pass that learning on to new analysts. Grâce à nos expertises pluridisciplinaires, nous concevons des sites de production, plateformes logistiques et bâtiments techniques qui répondent aux défis industriels, énergétiques et environnementaux de demain. Elcimaï Ingénierie recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) projet CVC Fluides confirmé(e) h/f en CDI A Melun (77 - France). Proche de la gare de Melun - 25 min de Paris Gare de Lyon (ligne R ou D) Au sein d'une équipe projet pluridisciplinaire, vous pilotez la conception et le suivi de réalisation des lots CVC - Fluides sur des projets de bâtiments industriels à forte valeur technique. jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame. This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain. What You'll Work On Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in. Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else. jobs.description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. Job title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer Location : Lausanne, Switzerland The Physical Design (PD) Engineer translates high-speed communication IP digital designs into physical GDSII layouts for advanced FinFET nodes. You will bridge logic design, owning block-to-chip implementation from netlist to final physical sign-off, ensuring PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) targets are met. Immediate key objective Drive block-level physical implementation—covering synthesis, SDC constraints, floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing—meeting strict frequency, area, and power targets. Execute timing closure across multiple corners and modes (MCMM) utilizing static timing analysis (STA) and generating targeted ECOs. Drive full physical verification closure sign-off in deep-submicron FinFET technologies. Responsibility Own block synthesis, floorplanning, placement optimization, CTS, and routing. Develop and refine SDC constraints to ensure design intent matches physical realization. Collaborate with the digital design team to resolve logic or architectural bottlenecks affecting P&R convergence. Generate progress reports, document implementation flows, and prepare sign-off packages for tape-out. Required Experience 5+ years of hands-on physical design experience focusing on synthesis, SDC constraints, CTS, and place and route for high-speed systems. Strong technical background in deep-submicron

Our mission is to make AI systems more scalable, efficient, and accessible. Today we have one internship position available for max 6 months, in our Advanced R&D, for MSc students in the following area : Signal Processing Internship Please note: This internship is intended for students who are currently enrolled at a university or higher education institution in Switzerland and already based in Switzerland . Internship Background Signal processing and modeling: the students will help model complex analog circuits using signal processing techniques. Knowledge of analog circuits is a plus, but we will be able to teach them the required knowledge if they have a firm knowledge of signal processing. Programming skills in Python, C, or C++ is a big plus. Duties and Responsibilities Support the Advanced R&D Team of the company in modeling new designs and architectures, Organize and maintain research findings in the company’s document management system, Lend support to other areas of the business in need of modeling. Requirements Strong background in Signal Processing, DSP, and communications (communication system, theoretical aspects, modulation schemes). Signal Processing, Communications, or Electrical Engineering major. Minimum Grade Point Average of 5.0, Familiar with C, C++, Python, Matlab, Strong verbal and written communication skills, Excellent analytical and verbal problem-solving skills, Ability to work well in teams, and: strong ethic and attention to detail. Benefits Gain hands-on experience in an industrial research lab, Shadowing knowledgeable professionals, Opportunity to see the inner workings of a startup, Compensation available. Access to very advanced process nodes Desired Background The project is suitable for motivated Master's students in Electrical Engineering, Microelec

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Zurich
jobs.description: Get to know us Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours. Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR) : Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions. The role To support the rapid expansion of the Ideals VDR line of business in Zurich , we are looking for a Business Development Manager / Enterprise Account Executive to focus on our Corporate segment. Unlike our advisory-focused motions, you will sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, and telecommunications). As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks. Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable. Why Ideals? High trust from sales peers: Ideals ranks among the top companies on RepVue , as rated by sales professionals. Great Place To Work® Certified in the UK and the US (2026). You’ll join a team of 20+ teammates in the DACH region. Growth opportunity: Accelerate your growth with a bootstrapped SaaS that's scaled revenue 4x (5x more projected in the next 5 years) with our flagship VDR product. Proven track record: Be part of an established org with over 18 years in the VDR business, 30% + YoY revenue growth, powering 10%+ of global M&A activity. jobs.description: The Learning Team at ClickHouse is growing fast as more users discover the power of ClickHouse and seek to understand how to use it effectively. As a Training Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating, managing, and supporting the logistics and administration of global training programs, with a focus on public and private instructor-led training events. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless event execution and a consistent, high-quality learner experience. What you will be doing: Here is a list of the typical tasks you would be performing as a Training Operations Specialist: Schedule and organize virtual and in-person training events, including registration page setup, Zoom configuration, and email communications. Coordinate training event logistics, including sourcing and booking venues, managing event requirements, coordinating instructor availability, and communicating with instructors and attendees. Manage event registration, monitor enrollment, send reminders, follow-up emails, and track attendance to ensure smooth event execution. Track and report training metrics, registration trends, attendance, and program outcomes to key stakeholders. Partner with Field Marketing teams to coordinate public training events, including event scheduling, registration monitoring, and promotional support. Collaborate with Sales teams to coordinate private training requests, manage scheduling and logistics, and support customer training needs. Work closely with the broader Training team to coordinate resources, streamline processes, and ensure consistent execution across training programs. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in training coordination, operations, event management, or a related role. jobs.description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Evals
jobs.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions. Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement. Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement. What We're Looking For Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features. Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes. Strong judgement

jobs.company: GbR mit Jan Kopf, Michael Kurz
jobs.description: Über uns Wir sind die LuxusKollektion, ein wachsendes Handelsunternehmen mit Sitz in Rosenberg im Ostalbkreis. Über zahlreiche Online-Marktplätze vertreiben wir Möbel, Wohnaccessoires und Haushaltsartikel in Deutschland, Frankreich, Italien, Spanien, Österreich und weiteren europäischen Ländern. Wir befinden uns auf Wachstumskurs: Neue internationale Märkte, zusätzliche Vertriebskanäle und stetig wachsende Anforderungen sorgen dafür, dass es bei uns nie langweilig wird. Damit unser Wachstum auch intern erfolgreich weitergeht, möchten wir unser Team verstärken. Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte kaufmännische Persönlichkeit, die bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce mitbringt, gerne organisiert und Lust hat, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Du unterstützt uns bei der Betreuung unserer internationalen Marktplätze, behältst den Überblick über kaufmännische Abläufe und bringst dich aktiv in die Organisation unseres Unternehmens ein. Gleichzeitig bekommst du die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch mehr Verantwortung im Personalbereich zu übernehmen. Wenn du gerne eigenständig arbeitest, den Überblick behältst und Freude daran hast, gemeinsam mit einem Unternehmen zu wachsen, bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Aufgaben Bei uns erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit kaufmännischen, organisatorischen und koordinierenden Aufgaben. Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle innerhalb unseres Unternehmens und unterstützt sowohl unsere E-Commerce-Abläufe als auch die Organisation unseres Teams. E-Commerce und kaufmännische Aufgaben Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Online-Marktplätze Pflege und Optimierung von Produktangeboten, Artikeldaten, Preisen und Sortimenten Überwachung unserer Marktplatzaktivitäten und Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe Unterstützung bei der Anbindung und dem Ausbau neuer internationaler Marktplätze Bearbeitung und Koordination marktplatzbezogener Vorgänge und kaufmännischer Prozesse Erken

jobs.title: Customer Success / Operations Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Birdsview Birdsview ist die Agentic Sales Platform für den E-Commerce: KI-Agenten, die autonom verkaufen - per E-Mail und direkt im Shop. Vor allem dort, wo Kataloge komplex sind und gute Beratung den Unterschied macht. Das Fundament ist die Birdsview Intelligence : eine Wissensschicht, die Sprachmodellen echte Retail-Verkaufsexpertise gibt. Sie versteht Kundenlebenszyklen (Lifecycle IQ), Produkte und wie sie zusammenpassen (Product IQ), Produktbilder (Vision IQ) und die Tonalität jeder Marke (Emotional IQ) — modellagnostisch und direkt auf den Daten des Shops. jobs.description: À propos de Symrise Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features. You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact. This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Exploring & Analyzing Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions
